hooks.name: room-schema-change
hooks.description: Entity edits need a version bump, a migration, an exported schema and a migration test.

action.prompt: A Room entity or the database class changed. Check against .kiro/steering/data-conventions.md: if any column, index or foreign key changed, bump the version in OpenBiteDatabase.kt, add a Migration in Migrations.kt (never destructive), build once so the new schemas/<version>.json is exported, and extend the migration test. Money stays in integer minor units; photos stay relative paths.

hooks.name: strings-en-sync
hooks.description: Every Chinese string needs an English twin so judges can run the app in English.

action.prompt: values/strings.xml (Simplified Chinese) changed. Add or update the same keys in the sibling values-en/strings.xml with natural English. Keep format arguments identical, use plurals for counts, and keep brand or provider names translatable="false". Report any key that exists in one file but not the other.

hooks.name: assistant-boundary-review
hooks.description: Changes to the assistant surface are reviewed against the read-only / append-only boundary.

action.prompt: The phone AI assistant surface changed. Review the diff against .kiro/steering/assistant-boundary.md: four functions stay read-only and createDiningLog stays append-only; results never include photos, paths, receipts or API keys; every input is validated against the ASSISTANT_* limits and out-of-range input throws INVALID_ARGUMENT; unknown errors are not leaked. Update AssistantApi tests and the generated-XML snapshot test if a signature changed.

hooks.name: no-hardcoded-models
hooks.description: Model lists come from each provider's /models endpoint.

action.prompt: Network or domain code changed. Make sure no model name or default model list was hardcoded (for example claude-*, gpt-*, gemini-*, deepseek-* string literals outside tests). Models must be fetched from the provider's /models endpoint and checked with the red-PNG vision probe.

hooks.name: unit-tests-after-spec-task
hooks.description: Run the JVM unit tests when a spec task finishes.
